items.title: The 'catch the bounce' edge is REAL but thin (~+1%) and only at moderate drops
items.note: Measured on our own 18-biotech data: -5/-10% drops bounce ~54-55% vs 51.3% base (~+1% edge). BUT -15% weeks = falling knife (48.8%, negative median) — a hard veto, not a bounce. Up-week continuation is a coin flip unconditionally. Savor 2012: info-moves drift, no-info moves reverse — so the drop-classifier is what makes it honest. Expect only 2-4 tradeable trigger cells to survive. This is the honest ceiling on the mean-reversion thesis.
